EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Comparative analysis against imagery of the preceding week shows that fleet replenishment vessel Sedne takes on fuel at the naval jetty.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Sedne (A-402), 3rd Naval Auxiliary Group.

3. Ground disturbance consistent with recent heavy vehicle movement is visible across approximately 10 per cent of the apron.

4. Comparison against imagery of 14 days earlier shows 22 additional objects present and no objects removed.

5. A single collection cannot distinguish preparation for movement from preparation for maintenance.
